needs_calls.reasoning: The room is businesses: brokerage owners and sales directors who talk in closed WhatsApp groups, on LinkedIn and at industry events, not in public forums. Public search gave 29 member records out of 1,472, and round 2 added only 8, so the room stopped as exhausted, not saturated; the calling-rule, lead follow-up and AML pains have no member voice at all.

suggested_pains_not_added: rera-exam-first-card: New agents must pay for a RERA course and pass the RERA exam before they get a first broker card and may work. 7 records in this batch show it (course cost pages, exam guides), all sellers and media, no member voice yet. The existing licence-card-renewals pain covers only yearly renewals, and earlier labelers kept first-card records out of it.
